question.:question/problem:
Find the value of ${x}_{1}-{x}_{4}$ given that  $6a-2x=b$ and

$$
a=\begin{bmatrix}4 \\ -1 \\ -4 \\ 1\end{bmatrix},\,x=\begin{bmatrix}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3} \\ {x}_{4}\end{bmatrix},\,b=\begin{bmatrix}22 \\ -4 \\ -12 \\ 24\end{bmatrix}.
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Using the properties of addition/subtraction and scalar multiplication of vectors to isolate $x,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}6a-2x & =b \\ -2x & =b-6a \\ x & =-\frac{1}{2}(b-6a) \\ x & =-\frac{1}{2}(\begin{bmatrix}22 \\ -4 \\ -12 \\ 24\end{bmatrix}-6\begin{bmatrix}4 \\ -1 \\ -4 \\ 1\end{bmatrix}) \\ x & =-\frac{1}{2}\begin{bmatrix}-2 \\ 2 \\ 12 \\ 18\end{bmatrix} \\ x & =\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ -1 \\ -6 \\ -9\end{bmatrix}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, ${x}_{1}-{x}_{4}=1-(-9)=10.$

Therefore, ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=1+9=10.$
